description: This Java class 'InterestRateChartSlabDataValidator' is a validator component for creating and updating interest rate chart slabs within the Fineract project. It performs validation on JSON input data for interest rate chart slabs, ensuring required fields are present and adhere to constraints, and handles incentives validation.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON request data for creating and updating interest rate chart slabs, including nested incentives validation.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating an interest rate chart slab, including mandatory fields and constraints.

methods.name: validateChartSlabsCreate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation on JSON data for creating an interest rate chart slab, including periods, amounts, interest rate, and incentives.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing interest rate chart slab.

methods.name: validateChartSlabsUpdate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation on JSON data for updating an interest rate chart slab, including optional fields and constraints.

methods.name: validateIncentives
methods.description: Validates the incentives array in the JSON data, delegating to 'interestIncentiveDataValidator'.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are present.
